messages:
alex: Quick handoff FYI — scheduling a low-risk release tonight in the 23:00 UTC window. Canary at +10m, ramp if clean. Tagging watchers @maria_g @jamal. Freeze window 22:50-23:35 UTC; exceptions only for rollback fixes.

maria_g: ack. I'll be primary watcher for canary + first hour. What are the two risky bits?

alex: mainly the embeddings index migration (background job) and a small cache schema change (in-place). Both idempotent but could bump worker memory for a short period. Expected QPS +~15% for /api/generate during ramp.

jamal: oncall for infra — I'll handle DB/caching issues. If the embed migration stalls, flip feature flag `emb_idx_migrate=false` and restart the migrator.

sophie: quick question — do we keep autoscaler active during canary? I'd prefer no autoshrink for 30m after canary go-live.

alex: good call. I'll set min replicas to current to avoid shrink:```
infractl scale --pool inference --min 6
```

maria_g: I'll monitor latency and error rates. Quick PromQL I'll run: `avg_over_time(latency_ms{route="/api/generate"}[5m])` and `sum(rate(http_requests_total{code!~"2.."}[1m]))`.

deployment-bot: deploy queued by @alex for 2026-03-18T23:00:00Z — canary targets: infra-pool-a (hosts 10.0.4.12-14). Smoke tests: runbook/smoke-quick.

oncall-bot: Reminder: post-deploy smoke check at +15m (automated), escalation if any 5xx > 1% over 5m.

jamal: rollback plan: use `deployment-bot rollback --to v1.3-quant` if >5% 5xx or embed migration fails to catch up in 20m. I'll be ready to trigger.

leo: FYI I'll be on standby for post-deploy smoke for ~45m. DM me if you need me to jump to the pager.

alex: small operational note: if KV cache pressure appears (mem_used > 78%), do a rolling restart of worker-3 pool rather than a full rollback. Doc link: https://goto/release-runbooks/kv-cache.

maria_g: copying handoff notes into the handoff doc. I'll post a short summary when the canary starts.

alex: handing off now. Final checklist done: smoke tests green locally, infra min scale set, watchers assigned. Ping in this thread for anything during the window. Good luck :thumbsup:

jamal: thanks — will watch metrics and DB migration logs. If anything weird, I'll post errors + top stack traces here.

sophie: noted. If autoscale hits unexpected behavior, set `autoscaler.pause=true` in infra console and notify.

alex: end of thread — leaving a brief log in #eng-oncall-runbook and updating the deploy ticket with timestamps.
